caption: The drawing depicts a single large, round-bottomed metal cauldron with two side handles attached near the rim. The cauldron is shown tilted, displaying its inner surface and the hardware securing the handles. The color of the cauldron is primarily a dull brownish-copper with areas of yellow and green discoloration, possibly suggesting patina or corrosion, especially along the inside and around the rivets. The handles are darker brown, and the rivets are depicted in a similar, slightly brighter metallic hue. The background is an unadorned, uniform off-white or beige, with no additional objects or ornamental features. The artist’s signature, "Wm. R. Ludwig," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Copper Candy Vessel
